gradeUp.top: This is the top grade. You can still refine topic levels with topic blocks.
gradeUp.hint: Worth trying {{grade}}: your level is already close
gradeUp.text: The {{grade}} test starts from scratch. Your category changes only if the grade is confirmed; otherwise it stays and the attempt is not lost.

stepDown.title: Move to {{grade}}?
stepDown.text: No test needed, the category changes right away. Moving back up takes a test and only after the waiting period.

skills.title: Skill profile
skills.lead: Level in each topic of your category with its margin of error. The narrower the band, the more precise.
skills.blockText: A topic block is a short test on this topic only. It narrows the margin of error and refines the level without changing your category or grade.

outcome.mismatch: Verification did not match the test

feedback.title: What moves you up
feedback.lead: How you look in employer shortlists. Companies and their needs stay undisclosed.
feedback.few: Too few shortlists with you in the last {{days}} days to show a position. General advice below.
feedback.fspText: Competition results become the strongest signal in your profile. There is no penalty without them.

scenario.narrow: Narrow the margin of error in {{topic}}
scenario.default: Refine your level in {{topic}}: the margin of error is widest here

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.emptyText: Employers find you in shortlists by category and reach out themselves. Refine your skill profile to rank higher.

profile.title: Profile
profile.text: Until you accept an invitation, employers see an anonymised card without your name, contacts and the fields you hid.

invitations.title: Invitations come after your category
invitations.text: Employers shortlist candidates by category: specialisation and grade confirmed by a test. Without a category you do not appear in shortlists, so nobody can invite you.

tasks.title: Tasks open after your category
tasks.text: Regular tasks are matched to your category and refine your skill profile. Complete the path to a category and tasks will appear here.
